title: projects/<project>/project.json: only what is specific to this project

slug.description: The folder name and the ZIP name. Never changes after release.

title.description: The name on the lesson's project card.

lessons.description: Every lesson that uses this project.

since.description: The first release that has it.

languages.description: Only when the project leaves out a course language; the lesson must say so. Default: every language in repo.json.

sources.description: Extra source files a language's commands must name, such as the .cpp files for g++.

rounds.description: Round 1 first. Round n's test file is named by tools/languages.json.

tests.description: Every test name in this round, the same in every language (compared ignoring case, spaces, _ and -).

starterPasses.description: Tests the starter already passes. It must fail every other test.

demo.description: false if the project has no demo program.

overrides.description: Only when a command really differs from the language default.
